author: videonerd5404
quote: The story forces you to play specific ways and if you don't, it punishes you. It has nothing to do with the same spirit that made GTA so great. This is more of a red dead redemption vibe. It's got the realistic parts that immerse you but make everything so unbearable you always need to eat to work out. You even have to fuel up your car. You can't just commit indiscriminate, murder, and grand theft whenever super frustrating and shameful.
